nodes.name: MergeRequest
props: merge_status:string — Mergeability status: unchecked, preparing, checking, can_be_merged, cannot_be_merged, cannot_be_merged_recheck, cannot_be_merged_rechecking.
draft:bool — Whether this is a draft/WIP merge request.
squash:bool — Whether to squash commits on merge.
project_id:int — Owning project ID. Stored on the node for redaction without an edge lookup.
merged_commit_id:int? — Synthetic Commit id the MR was merged at. NULL until merged, then immutable.
latest_build_started_at:datetime? — Latest CI build start timestamp.
latest_build_finished_at:datetime? — Latest CI build finish timestamp.
diff_size:int? — Total diff size in bytes.
modified_paths_size:int? — Number of modified file paths.
added_lines:int? — Lines added across all files.
removed_lines:int? — Lines removed across all files.
first_contribution:bool — Whether this is the author's first contribution to the project.
updated_by_id:int? — User ID who last updated.
last_edited_by_id:int? — User ID who last edited the description.
closed_by_id:int? — User ID who most recently closed.
source_project_id:int? — Source project ID (may differ from target for cross-project MRs).
head_pipeline_id:int? — Pipeline ID on the head commit.
latest_merge_request_diff_id:int? — Most recent diff snapshot ID.
diff:string? — Full unified diff. Resolved from GitLab at query time.

nodes.name: User
props: email:string — Primary email. Admins only until per-cell authz lands (gated by `read_user_email_address`).
first_name:string — First name. Not on any public surface; admins only.
last_name:string — Last name. Not on any public surface; admins only.
updated_at:datetime? — Last update timestamp. Not on any public surface; admins only.
avatar_url:string? — Avatar upload filename (not a URL; the full URL is computed at runtime).
preferred_language:string — Preferred UI language. Self-only on REST; admins only until per-cell authz lands.
private_profile:bool — Private profile flag. Self-only on REST; admins only here.
is_external:bool — External user flag. Self-only on REST, admin-only via UserWithAdmin; admins only here.

nodes.name: File
props: path:string — Relative path within the repository.
language:string — Programming language (e.g., ruby, python, java).
size_bytes:int — Uncompressed file size in bytes, measured at index time.
content:string? — Raw source text, resolved from Gitaly at query time.
reason:string — Why the file was skipped or failed to index (e.g. oversize, timeout_parse, invalid_utf8). Empty for files indexed successfully.
